question: 2013 年户均持仓市值是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_holdings.CurrentValue) / COUNT(DISTINCT fact_holdings.SK_AccountID) AS average_holding_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_holdings AS fact_holdings INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_holdings.SK_DateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 户均持仓市值 = 持仓总市值 / 有持仓的去重账户数（fact_holdings 域首个黄金样本，口径锚定）
